messages:
Priya K.: Noticed a repeat of last week's pattern: spike in /v1/generate P95 starting 02:12 UTC. Opening a thread to capture short-term SLO changes and owners for remediation.

Ben (oncall): Error budget burn is ~25% over 24h, with a throughput drop ~15% during the spike. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/s/latency-throughput. P95 went from 180ms -> ~540ms for 20m.

Jasper T.: Traces show request queuing on ingress when controller node was briefly cordoned for infra maintenance. Queue backlog + larger batch windows created tail. Root cause: maintenance window overlap + no scale-grace.

Omar R.: I can update dashboards and add a temporary SLO panel highlighting ingress queue depth by AZ. Will PR today. Also add an alert for sudden throughput drop to catch this earlier.

Lena V.: Recommend temporary P95 SLO exception (180ms -> 240ms) for 48h with explicit rollback and a postmortem follow-up. Also want a new SLA note for customers impacted during maintenance windows.

Priya K.: I'll own the autoscaler/grace tuning work and run a canary. Ticket INF-2001 created: "autoscale grace + ingress backpressure mitigation". ETA: 36h. Link: https://tickets.redwood/internal/INF-2001.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-091 opened: ingress queue/backpressure -> latency spike. Severity: Sev3. Pager muted per oncall. (automated)

Ben (oncall): I'll apply temp SLO relaxation and change alert thresholds to suppress noisy paging. Changing alert P95 firing from 200ms -> 260ms and adding a 30m suppress window for flapping. Will attach PR after change.

Omar R.: Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood/dashboards/pulls/459. Panels: ingress_queue_by_az, per-model_batch_ms, throughput_approx. Request review from @Lena V.

Lena V.: Reviewing. Also adding a short runbook stub for maintenance-time safeguards (how to schedule infra work without impacting serving). Will add section: "maintenance: avoid cordon during active autoscale windows". ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Priya K.: Canary snippet for autoscaler change:
```
autoscaler:
  min_nodes: 3
  scale_down_grace_s: 120
  ingress_backpressure_threshold: 0.7
```
Will canary on a subset of clusters and report after 1h.

Jasper T.: Adding recurring-incident tag in the quarterly tracker: "ingress-maintenance-backpressure". Suggest priority 2 to schedule a platform fix next sprint.

Lena V.: Agree. Weekly check-ins until the infra strategy is adjusted. Also we should correlate maintenance logs + deploy windows to avoid repeating.

Ben (oncall): PR applied for alert change and suppression. Monitor created to watch error budget delta. I'll post burn numbers in 6h.

Priya K.: Canary started on 10% of traffic. Early signal: P95 on canary nodes down to ~170ms. If stable, will roll to 50% in 30m.

IncidentBot: INF-2001 status -> in_progress (Priya K.).

Omar R.: Merged dashboard PR. Added link to incident and INF-2001 in the panel description.

Ben (oncall): Error budget burn dropped to 6% over the 6h window after canary. Good sign.

Lena V.: Runbook and maintenance section merged. Also added a checklist for oncall: pre-maintenance checklist to validate autoscale warmup.

Priya K.: Full rollout complete. INF-2001 marked resolved after roll and validation. Perf results: https://perf.redwood/results/inf-2001-final.

Lena V.: Temporary SLO exception created at 02:25 UTC for 48h, rollback scheduled unless rollout completes earlier. Documented in the SLO policy change log.

Jasper T.: Added this incident to quarterly recurring incidents sheet and flagged follow-up action: platform sprint Q3 - ingress controller redesign.

Ben (oncall): No regressions in last 18h. Will close the monitoring loop tomorrow if stable.

Priya K.: Closing note: owners and timelines tracked (INF-2001), dashboards updated, runbook + maintenance guardrails added. Recommend a short cross-team retro to discuss scheduling/maintenance process.

(End of thread)
